map_space.world_coord_role: chunk world_xz is converted to vanilla map_uv/map_px before sampling pdxmap resources

legacy_art_features.river_overlay_fallback: enabled only when the dedicated river pass is unavailable
legacy_art_features.water_final_color_fallback: enabled only when the dedicated water pass is unavailable
legacy_art_features.sdf_border_fallback: enabled only when the dedicated border pass is unavailable

political_tint.close_view_rule: political color remains visible at close gameplay zoom while atlas/colormap/normal detail is preserved

composition_order: political tint budget over terrain albedo
MudSnow target -> mud diffuse/normal and snow diffuse/normal
river/occupation/selection/hover overlays only through ownership gates

responsibility_boundary.terrain: land base material, political tint, terrain atlas, colormap, snow/mud, FOW, day/night, distance fog
responsibility_boundary.water: dedicated water pass owns visible water color when available
responsibility_boundary.border: dedicated border pass owns province/country boundary color when available
responsibility_boundary.postprocess: global LUT, tonemap, bloom, and final sRGB conversion remain outside pdxmap

bindings.visual_impact: terrain diffuse atlas falls back to a white texture
terrain lighting and material normals flatten
large-scale terrain lighting normal falls back to flat
terrain natural color base falls back to neutral gray
snow overlay loses vanilla normal/diffuse texture
mud overlay falls back to a flat brown tint

bindings.dimensions: 384x1 texels: MAX_POINT_LIGHTS(192) * 2 RGBA32F texels per light
bindings.source_trace: tools/vanilla_trace/runtime_targets.json render target/SRV census plus shader_bindings.json and render_passes.json resource name LightDataMap
bindings.parity_status: trace-backed binding and project-generated light data; not copied from vanilla runtime memory
bindings.visual_impact: night lighting and local highlights use generated point light data

bindings.dimensions: tile grid: ceil(province_map / 16px), width aligned to 64 texels; RGBA packs up to 4 light ids with 255 sentinel

bindings.parity_status: trace-backed binding and project-derived 16px tile rule; not copied from vanilla runtime memory
bindings.visual_impact: point light lookup uses a generated tile index
